# level-03-first-aspnet-core-api Lesson 04: Run the app

## 1) Goal
- Run the first ASP.NET Core API and call one endpoint.

## 2) Complete working code
```csharp
// Program.cs (already generated by `dotnet new webapi`)
// Keep default code for this lesson and just run it.
```

## 3) Comments explaining important lines
- The default template maps `/weatherforecast` as a starter GET endpoint.
- Swagger UI is enabled in development mode for easy testing.

## 4) Commands to run the code
```bash
cd src/LearnCSharpApiDevelopment.Api
dotnet run
```

## 5) Example API request
```http
GET /weatherforecast HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:5000
```

## 6) Expected API response
```json
[
  {
    "date": "2026-09-01",
    "temperatureC": 10,
    "summary": "Mild",
    "temperatureF": 49
  }
]
```

## 7) Common mistakes
- Calling the wrong port.
- Stopping the app before sending the request.

## 8) Small practice task
- Run the API and open Swagger at `/swagger`.

## 9) Complete task solution
```bash
cd src/LearnCSharpApiDevelopment.Api
dotnet run
# Open browser: http://localhost:<port>/swagger
```
